modern: How plain it is that there is no other condition of life so well suited for philosophising as the one you now happen to be in.
original: How plain does it appear that there is not another condition of life so well suited for philosophizing as this in which thou now happenest to be.
notification: How plain it is that there is no other condition of life so well suited for philosophising as the one you now happen to be in.
notification_original: How plain does it appear that there is not another condition of life so well suited for philosophizing as this in which thou now happenest to be.

explained.summary: There is no better situation for living wisely than the one you’re in right now. Marcus is talking to himself, an emperor with endless duties, and refusing the excuse that philosophy would be easier somewhere quieter. Your actual circumstances, whatever they are, are the material you practise on.
explained.today: It’s tempting to think you’ll be calmer once the house move is done, the children are older or the job is less hectic. The difficult boss, the noisy flat and the busy week are exactly where patience and good judgement get exercised.
